{
  "analysis": "The Python patch script failed with a syntax error, so the JR/JALR return values weren't applied. The VM is still stuck at fwrite. I need to properly fix the execSpecial/execRegimm return values. Let me use a more robust approach - rewrite the affected functions directly using a Python script with proper string handling.",
  "plan": "Use a Python script with proper string handling to fix execSpecial and execRegimm to return true for branches/jumps, and update execute() to check return values. Then re-test.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "python3 <<'PY'
import re

src = open('/app/vm.js').read()

# Fix execute() to check return values
src = src.replace(
    "      case 0x00: // SPECIAL\n        this.execSpecial(inst, curPC);\n        break;",
    "      case 0x00: // SPECIAL\n        if (this.execSpecial(inst, curPC)) return;\n        break;"
)
src = src.replace(
    "      case 0x01: // REGIMM\n        this.execRegimm(inst, curPC);\n        break;",
    "      case 0x01: // REGIMM\n        if (this.execRegimm(inst, curPC)) return;\n        break;"
)

# Fix JR and JALR to return true
src = src.replace(
    "        this.executeDelayAndJump((curPC + 4) >>> 0, target);\n        return;\n      }\n      case 0x0c: // SYSCALL",
    "        this.executeDelayAndJump((curPC + 4) >>> 0, target);\n        return true;\n      }\n      case 0x0c: // SYSCALL"
)

# Fix JALR (second occurrence)
src = src.replace(
    "        this.setReg(rd === 0 ? 31 : rd, (curPC + 8) >>> 0);\n        this.executeDelayAndJump((curPC + 4) >>> 0, target);\n        return;\n      }\n      case 0x0d: // BREAK",
    "        this.setReg(rd === 0 ? 31 : rd, (curPC + 8) >>> 0);\n        this.executeDelayAndJump((curPC + 4) >>> 0, target);\n        return true;\n      }\n      case 0x0d: // BREAK"
)

# Add return false at end of execSpecial (before the closing brace after default)
# Find the end of execSpecial - it ends with the default case and closing brace
# The pattern is: break;\n    }\n  }\n\n  execRegimm
src = src.replace(
    "        this.halt(`unknown special funct 0x${funct.toString(16)} inst=0x${inst.toString(16)} pc=0x${curPC.toString(16)}`);\n        break;\n    }\n  }\n\n  execRegimm",
    "        this.halt(`unknown special funct 0x${funct.toString(16)} inst=0x${inst.toString(16)} pc=0x${curPC.toString(16)}`);\n        break;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  execRegimm"
)

# Fix execRegimm return true for BLTZ and BGEZ
src = src.replace(
    "if ((this.r[rs] | 0) < 0) { this.executeDelayAndJump(delayPC, target); return; }",
    "if ((this.r[rs] | 0) < 0) { this.executeDelayAndJump(delayPC, target); return true; }"
)
src = src.replace(
    "if ((this.r[rs] | 0) >= 0) { this.executeDelayAndJump(delayPC, target); return; }",
    "if ((this.r[rs] | 0) >= 0) { this.executeDelayAndJump(delayPC, target); return true; }"
)

# Fix BLTZL, BGEZL, BLTZAL, BGEZAL, BLTZALL, BGEZALL - they use 'return;' after executeDelayAndJump
# These are in execRegimm and use 'return;' in the 'if' branch
src = src.replace(
    "if ((this.r[rs] | 0) < 0) { this.executeDelayAndJump(delayPC, target); return; }\n        else this.pc = (curPC + 8) >>> 0;",
    "if ((this.r[rs] | 0) < 0) { this.executeDelayAndJump(delayPC, target); return true; }\n        else this.pc = (curPC + 8) >>> 0;"
)
src = src.replace(
    "if ((this.r[rs] | 0) >= 0) { this.executeDelayAndJump(delayPC, target); return; }\n        else this.pc = (curPC + 8) >>> 0;",
    "if ((this.r[rs] | 0) >= 0) { this.executeDelayAndJump(delayPC, target); return true; }\n        else this.pc = (curPC + 8) >>> 0;"
)

# Add return false at end of execRegimm
src = src.replace(
    "        this.halt(`unknown REGIMM rt 0x${rt.toString(16)} inst=0x${inst.toString(16)} pc=0x${curPC.toString(16)}`);\n        break;\n    }\n  }\n\n  execFPU",
    "        this.halt(`unknown REGIMM rt 0x${rt.toString(16)} inst=0x${inst.toString(16)} pc=0x${curPC.toString(16)}`);\n        break;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  execFPU"
)

open('/app/vm.js', 'w').write(src)
PY
node -c /app/vm.js
",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "rm -f /tmp/frame.bmp /tmp/vm_out.txt; timeout 30 node /app/vm.js > /tmp/vm_out.txt 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; wc -l /tmp/vm_out.txt; head -20 /tmp/vm_out.txt; echo '...'; tail -10 /tmp/vm_out.txt; ls -la /tmp/frame.bmp 2>/dev/null
",
      "duration": 32.0
    }
  ]
}
